name: 20978-longdecode-30ba3b-tp4dp2
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, bf16, unquantized. Ungated and already in the local HF cache.
parallelism: TP=4 with attention data parallelism at DP=2 -- two attention groups of two ranks each, while the experts stay four-rank tensor parallel. EP=1, PP=1, no context parallelism, one node.
architecture: Qwen3MoeForCausalLM, 30.5B total parameters with ~3B active per token, 48 sparse decoder layers, 128 routed experts at top-8. Further detail is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=70, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 560 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, static seed 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no prefix reuse: ~4096 prompt tokens in (stdev 256, clamped 3072-5120) and EXACTLY 1024 tokens out with no spread, `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A long-form report writer turning 4,000-word briefs into 1,024-token drafts for 70 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit ce0541404fec75d3f15afac407c0a3e90c0546d5, four GPUs of one node serving an
# unquantized bf16 MoE with attention data parallelism narrower than the tensor-parallel world.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507

# `tp-size` is the world size; `dp-size` is how many attention data-parallel groups it is cut
# into. Both are part of the declared topology.
tp-size: 4
enable-dp-attention: true
dp-size: 2

max-running-requests: 70

# The workload's longest request is ~5120 tokens; the checkpoint's advertised 262144 would size
# the engine for a context nothing here ever asks for.
context-length: 8192

# Prompts are drawn independently and share no prefix, so the tree can only cost and never hit.
disable-radix-cache: true
